title: server.enroll (platform → host)
description: Existing servers enroll on this platform: the host writes enroll_key (a fleet key the platform mints when it sends the command, limited to these servers) into each server's cfg/ReadyUp/fleet.cfg and restarts the running ones; their Ready Up's old credentials are refused and it enrolls again with the new key. A stopped server enrolls when it starts. For a machine linked again (e.g. to a fresh install): its servers come back without being created again. Disruptive like server.restart (refused during a match unless force). Capability servers.enroll. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock.
